policies.name: Disk encryption enabled
policies.query: SELECT 1 FROM disk_encryption WHERE user_uuid IS NOT NULL AND filevault_status = 'on';
policies.description: Checks that FileVault is enabled on the startup volume.
policies.resolution: Turn on FileVault in System Settings, Privacy & Security.

policies.name: Screen lock after 15 minutes
policies.query: SELECT 1 FROM screenlock WHERE enabled = 1 AND grace_period <= 900;
policies.description: Checks that the screen locks within 15 minutes.
policies.resolution: Set the screen lock to 15 minutes or less.

policies.name: Automatic updates enabled
policies.description: Checks that automatic updates are on.

policies.name: Disk encryption enabled
policies.description: Checks that the root volume is encrypted.
